decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (306-A1-100 and design and access statement received on 08/02/2013, location plan received on 11/04/2013 and 306-A1-101 Rev A and lighting details received on 09/05/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The lighting to the side passage to the residential units above 348 Bath Road shall be installed within three months from the date of this permission and maintained thereafter in accordance with the approved details (Plan Nos. 306-A1-101 Rev A and lighting details received on 09/05/2013).
description: Retention of a single storey rear extension to the restaurant.
